app-title.purpose: Popup name in the header (Helios display-300).

section-title.purpose: Card headings and card names in results (display-200).

supporting.purpose: Helper text, conditions, notes (body-100, faint ink).

amount.purpose: Unbroken, tabular estimate amounts and ranges (display-200).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied globally when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce; Helios component transitions otherwise.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Helios Button color=primary: compare, save, protect and unlock; loading state keeps width and name.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Helios Button color=secondary: read cart, cancel, lock, check for updated terms.

components.name: Critical Button
components.description: Helios Button color=critical: delete all local data, enabled only after explicit confirmation.
components.html: <button class="ac-button ac-button--critical ac-button--medium">Delete all local data</button>

components.name: Field
components.description: Helios form field: label, helper text, error text wired with aria-describedby; TextInput or Select control.

components.name: Card Fieldset
components.description: One Helios Fieldset per issuer with a Checkbox per card product.

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Helios Card (base level, border) for each content group.

components.name: Inline Alert
components.description: Helios AlertInline: critical errors and expired terms (role=alert), notices (role=status), highlight cart reads, warning uncovered merchant.

components.name: Condition Badge
components.description: Helios Badge (small): U.S. merchants only, spend cap and after-cap rate, enrollment or activation required.

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary styled after the Helios accordion: rules that don’t apply here, sources, data details, deletion.

narrative.overview: The popup is a compact working form built on Helios (HashiCorp's design system) through packages/ui: Helios design tokens and React components written to the Helios specs. AI Checkout keeps its own name and cart icon. Every estimate carries its basis: merchant, amount type, the issuer's rule wording, conditions and sources.
keyCharacteristics: One fixed 360 px scrolling column (never wider than 480 px).
Helios tokens for every color, type size, radius and shadow; Tailwind for layout only.
Helios components: labelled fields, token-styled native controls, semantic inline alerts.
Wallet grouped by issuer with rule-derived inputs; no hard-coded card or rule IDs.
Results show the issuer's rule wording, conditions, the pay-later note and rules that don't apply.
Axe-clean at 360 and 480 px in every main state.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Use --token-* variables (directly or through the token-mapped Tailwind scales); never add raw colors, sizes, radii or shadows.

rules.name: The Amount Legibility Rule
rules.body: Keep reward values on one line with tabular numerals; let card names and conditions wrap.

rules.name: The Single Column Rule
rules.body: Extend the popup through vertical flow and scrolling at 360 px; never exceed 480 px.

rules.name: The Visible Basis Rule
rules.body: Keep merchant, amount basis, the issuer's rule wording, conditions and uncertainty next to the estimate.

rules.name: The Rule-Derived Input Rule
rules.body: Derive wallet inputs and labels from catalog rules; activation is asked only for enroll-once or recurring rules.

rules.name: The Explicit Deletion Rule
rules.body: Keep the permanent-delete consequence, confirmation and critical action together.

rules.name: The Cart Silhouette Rule
rules.body: Keep the white geometric cart on its blue field recognizable at small sizes; export from the shared vector.

dos: Use @ai-checkout/ui components and --token-* variables before adding anything new.
Keep merchant, amount basis, rule wording, conditions and uncertainty next to the estimate.
Derive card-specific inputs from catalog rules.
Keep protection wording accurate to the storage state.
Distinguish release-media captions from actual UI; label sample inputs.
donts: Don't add raw colors, font sizes, radii or shadows.
Don't color reward amounts as a success claim or hide conditions in the sources.
Don't hard-code card or rule IDs in the UI.
Don't widen the popup beyond 480 px or add a second column.
